title: Attention-guided super-resolution of 4D flow MRI in carotid arteries
abstract: arXiv:2609.04891v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Four-dimensional (4D) flow magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a powerful non-invasive technique for visualizing and quantifying complex blood flow patterns in vivo. Despite its clinical promise, broader adoption is limited by low spatial resolution and sensitivity to noise, which restrict accurate assessment of critical hemodynamic biomarkers such as wall shear stress, pressure gradients, and turbulent kinetic energy. To overcome these challenges, we propose a deep learning-based super-resolution framework that integrates multi-scale feature extraction and attention mechanisms to enhance the quality of 4D flow MRI data.   The model was trained on a dataset of 120 patients with 240 stenosed carotid arteries. translated_title: 基于注意力引导的颈动脉4D流动磁共振成像超分辨率方法
translated_abstract: 四维（4D）流动磁共振成像（MRI）是一种强大的无创技术，可用于可视化和定量分析体内复杂的血流模式。尽管其具有临床应用前景，但更广泛的推广受到低空间分辨率和噪声敏感性的限制，这影响了对壁面剪切应力、压力梯度和湍流动能等关键血流动力学生物标志物的准确评估。为克服这些挑战，我们提出了一种基于深度学习的超分辨率框架，该框架集成了多尺度特征提取和注意力机制，以提升4D流动MRI数据的质量。该模型在包含120名患者、240条狭窄颈动脉的数据集上进行了训练。高分辨率真实值数据基于分割的血管几何结构和符合生理的边界条件，通过患者特定的计算流体动力学（CFD）模拟生成，所得的速度场……
tldr: 该研究提出了一种融合多尺度特征提取与注意力机制的深度学习超分辨率框架，并利用基于患者特定CFD模拟生成的高分辨率数据进行训练，有效提升了颈动脉4D流动MRI的分辨率与血流动力学指标评估精度。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a deep learning super-resolution framework integrating multi-scale feature extraction and attention mechanisms, trained on high-resolution data from patient-specific CFD simulations, to enhance the quality of 4D flow MRI in carotid arteries for accurate hemodynamic assessment.
